fact: The mid-term evaluation of PASS Sutura, dated March 2025 on data collected in November 2024, says the project's digitalisation, computerised medical records among it, is in place in integrated health centres and district hospitals of the three target districts, Dioundiou, Gothèye and Gaya, with the ministry's direction de la santé numérique involved, and is paid for by the Niger-Belgium programme (EUR 14.5 million for health) and a Netherlands co-financing of EUR 3.2 million for 1 January 2023 to 31 March 2025 with an emphasis on digitalisation; it gives no facility count.
title: Évaluation à mi-parcours du Projet d'Appui du Système de Santé « PASS Sutura » : Résumé exécutif
